tier1.text: Each posterior tibial artery brings blood to the muscles and skin at the back of the lower leg. This artery branches off the popliteal artery, which runs behind the knee. The posterior tibial artery runs down along the tibia, or shinbone, to the ankle. The artery's branches also supply the foot.
